before.requirement: Parse a four-component v line into a dedicated vertex-weight value.
before.reason: The old vertex path tests for three color components and does not extract the fourth component into a separate vertex-weight vector.

after.requirement: For a four-component v line, retain the fourth component as a vertex weight.
after.reason: The parser recognizes four components, appends the fourth value to vertex_weights, and publishes that vector. The harness can supply such an OBJ line before a NUL delimiter.

claims.reason: The capability is added after the change, and the existing input split can reach it.

before.requirement: With vertex-color fallback disabled, accept an OBJ vertex without RGB components without supplying fallback colors.
before.reason: The old loader has a disabled-fallback path. Whether the old harness can select it depends on the missing ObjReaderConfig default.

after.requirement: With vertex-color fallback disabled, accept an OBJ vertex without RGB components without supplying fallback colors.
after.reason: The changed loader retains the disabled-fallback path. The same missing configuration default prevents determining whether the old harness reaches it.

claims.reason: The same default-constructed configuration is used on both sides. Its vertex_color value determines whether this behavior is reachable.

before.requirement: If supported, preserve a polygon face without triangulating it when config.triangulate is false.

after.requirement: If supported, preserve a polygon face without triangulating it when config.triangulate is false.
after.reason: The changed loader still forwards the setting; the same missing helper and default prevent a definitive assessment.
